description: NetFlow v9 analytics from Proxmox hypervisor: flow rates, bandwidth, transport breakdown, top talkers by source/destination, service port analysis, flow locality, and raw flow detail.

panels.title: Total Flows
panels.description:
Total number of NetFlow records. Each record represents a unidirectional flow between two endpoints.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Total Bandwidth
panels.description:
Sum of all bytes across all flows. Measures total traffic traversing the Proxmox hypervisor bridge.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Total Packets
panels.description:
Sum of all packets across all flows. High packet counts with low bytes may indicate scanning or keepalive traffic.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Unique Sources
panels.description:
Cardinality of source IP addresses. Measures how many hosts are originating traffic.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Unique Destinations
panels.description:
Cardinality of destination IP addresses. Measures how many hosts are receiving traffic.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Avg Flow Duration
panels.description:
Average duration of flows (start to end). Long flows suggest persistent connections; short flows suggest request-response patterns.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Flow Rate Over Time
panels.description:
Number of flow records per interval. Tracks overall connection activity on the hypervisor bridge.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Bandwidth Over Time
panels.description:
Total bytes per interval across all flows. Shows bandwidth utilization patterns over time.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Flows by Transport
panels.description:
Flow count split by transport protocol (TCP, UDP, ICMP). Reveals the protocol mix on the network.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Bandwidth by Transport
panels.description:
Bytes split by transport protocol. TCP typically dominates; high UDP may indicate DNS, syslog, or NTP traffic.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Flow Direction
panels.description:
Flow count by direction (internal, inbound, outbound). Internal flows stay within the 172.30.0.0/16 network.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Top Sources by Bytes
panels.description:
Top 10 source IPs by total bytes sent. Identifies which hosts generate the most outbound traffic.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Top Destinations by Bytes
panels.description:
Top 10 destination IPs by total bytes received. Identifies which services consume the most bandwidth.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Flows by Destination Port
panels.description:
Flow count by destination port. Maps to service usage: 9200 (ES HTTP), 9300 (ES transport), 3000 (Grafana), 8220 (Fleet).
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Bandwidth by Destination Port
panels.description:
Bytes by destination port. Shows which services consume the most bandwidth.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Flow Locality
panels.description:
Flow locality classification: internal (both endpoints private), inbound (external→internal), outbound (internal→external).
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Network Type (IPv4/IPv6)
panels.description:
Flow count by IP version. Our environment is primarily IPv4; IPv6 flows indicate NDP or dual-stack services.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Packets Over Time
panels.description:
Total packet count per interval. Complements bandwidth — high packets with low bytes indicates small-packet traffic.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

panels.title: Flow Detail
panels.description:
Raw NetFlow records: source/destination IP and port, transport, bytes, packets, direction, locality, and duration.
Source: NetFlow integration → netflow.log (softflowd on Proxmox → Elastic Agent)

title: NT-05 NetFlow Analytics
